title: What came between Aceh Sultanate and United States of Indonesia?
question: What came between Aceh Sultanate and United States of Indonesia?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Aceh Sultanate (1496) to United States of Indonesia (1949): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
